newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all dip, except HS fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all dip, except HS fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were all weaker with the exception of steady high sulphur fuel oil.
Naphtha extended Friday's sharp losses by a further $4 with some heavy trade selling reported on the swaps market.
Gasoline was easier. Eurograde barges were valued around $2 lower at $200 for refinery Rotterdam materila.
The March Eurograde/Naphtha spread traded actively around $10.50.
High sulphur fuel oil was stable, while low sulphur fuel lost a couple of dollars, pressured by cheap transatlantic avails.
Gas oil fell by $2 or so on the back of weaker futures, although premiums actually held in a quiet market.
